description: Read the manifest for the AI Hotel Landscape dataset: which AI platforms are tracked (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, Copilot, Google AI Mode) and whether each is still active, which of the 56 destinations are covered, which weekly snapshots exist, and the licence and refresh cadence. Call this FIRST before any other landscape tool, because it gives you the exact platform ids, city slugs and week dates the other tools expect. Use it whenever the user asks what data is available about how AI assistants recommend hotels.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

name: get_ai_hotel_landscape_manifest
